name: immoadv-browser
description: ImmoAdv Browser – eigener Browser auf Chromium-Basis mit NordVPN, Blocker, Passwörtern, KI-Assistent und Arbeitsbereichen
author: Feray Korkmaz

scripts.dist:win: node scripts/fetch-vendor.mjs && node scripts/build-rules.mjs && node scripts/ensure-release.mjs && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish always && node scripts/finalize-release.mjs
scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/fetch-vendor.mjs && node scripts/build-rules.mjs && node scripts/ensure-release.mjs && electron-builder --mac --universal --publish always && node scripts/finalize-release.mjs
